$comment: Customer-facing strings for the screens in Part 2. Keys are screen.element. Legal owner and review date on lines that make a claim.
cost.title: Before you share your SSN, here is what an advance costs
cost.example.body: You repay $340 a week for 10 weeks. Total paid back: $3,400. Pay it off early and you get a discount.
cost.row.payments: Automatic, weekly, from the bank account you connect
cost.row.fees: Same-day transfer, failed payment and default fees exist; the exact amounts are on your offer before you sign
cost.row.credit: Identity and bank activity, not your credit score
cost.row.notaloan: Fundo buys a share of your future sales. There is no interest rate, which is why we show the total you pay back
cost.row.qualify: 3 months in business, $1,500 a month in deposits. Not in California or New York, not W-2-only
cost.next: Next: your SSN (30 seconds), your bank through Plaid (2 minutes), your offer with the weekly payment and total shown before you accept anything.
cost.foot: Example uses a 1.7 factor over 10 weeks, a publicly reported Fundo rate. Your offer depends on your bank activity and is shown before you sign.
ssn.title: Confirm it's you with your Social Security number
ssn.why: We match your SSN to your name and date of birth to confirm your identity and prevent fraud. We check your identity, not your credit. This does not affect your score.
ssn.help: Encrypted in transit and stored securely. Shown masked once you enter it.
ssn.next: Next: a secure bank connection through Plaid, then your offer with the weekly payment and total shown before you accept.
ssn.exit: Prefer not to continue? Save and come back later or ask a question. You can stop at any time. Nothing is funded until you accept an offer.
ssn.error.mismatch: This number doesn't match the name and date of birth you entered. Check the digits, or go back to fix your name or birth date.
ssn.error.tries: Two more tries before we ask you to verify another way.
declined.title: We can't fund you today, and here is why
declined.body: This decision used your bank activity only. It did not touch your credit score.
state.title: We can't fund businesses in California yet
state.body: You selected California as your state of residence. Fundo's advances aren't offered there or in New York. We stopped here so you don't share your date of birth or SSN for nothing.
returning.title: Pick up where you left off
returning.body: This email has an application in progress. We'll text a code to the phone number on it to make sure it's you, then you continue from your last screen.
slow.title: Checking your identity
slow.toast: Your connection is slow. We're still working; keep this screen open or we'll text you a link to continue.
